description: Main window: core IPC, showing the window once the page has its theme, window theme (follows the Light/Dark setting), webview zoom (the Interface scale setting) + native open-folder / confirm dialogs, the Dock badge (how many agents in the terminals wait for the user), and the updater: checking GitHub Releases, downloading and installing an update, then restarting into it. All file and git access goes through our own commands, which are confined to the opened repo. Notifications go through our own commands too, which apply the user's switches; the notification plugin's page script only reads whether they are allowed, at load (allow-is-permission-granted), and can't send any.
